offer.text: A child in the next house burns with fever and the sickness is spreading fast. Bring me 4 glistering melon slices — quickly, before it takes a turn we can't undo.

accept.text: Hurry, please. Every minute the fever climbs.

decline.text: Then I'll do what little I can with what I have. Pray it's enough.

in_progress.text: Do you have the medicine? The fever's still rising.

ready.text: You made it in time — give them here, quickly.

complete.text: The fever broke before dawn. You saved a life today, and the village won't forget it.

failed.text: You came too late. The fever crested and the child slipped into a dangerous sleep. There may yet be a way to set this right — come speak with me.
